# SKILL-VALIDATOR

Use this skill when creating or updating repository skill files in `.github/skills/`.

## Checklist

- Keep the file name in the `SKILL-*.md` format.
- Make the guidance specific to this repository.
- Avoid references to tools, paths, commands, or workflows that do not exist here.
- Keep the skill short, direct, and easy for other agents to apply.
- If a routing file references a skill, make sure that skill exists.
